title: Myth vs. Fact: Chemical Drain Cleaners
description: Many homeowners rely on liquid chemical drain cleaners as a quick fix for clogged pipes. However, harsh chemical drain openers can generate intense heat through exothermic reactions, potentially softening PVC pipes and corroding older metal lines. Furthermore, if the chemical fails to clear the obstruction, it leaves a trap full of caustic standing liquid that poses a serious chemical burn hazard to plumbers working on the line. Professional drain cleaning relies on mechanical augers or hydro-jetting to safely and effectively clear obstructions without causing structural pipe damage or introducing severe chemical hazards.
